content.body:
## 2026 Summer Camps are Full

Our 2026 Nature Center summer camps are all full. If you would like to be notified when spaces become available, [please join the email notification list](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/2045542/1717219/).

[Summer Camp Notifications](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/2045542/1717219/)

Our camps are designed to encourage wonder and excitement for nature through hands-on activities, games, crafts, and exploration. Campers learn about their environment, gain new skills and develop their confidence by spending time exploring the outdoors.

## New for 2026

- **Updated age requirement**: 2026 Summer Camp will serve campers **age 7-11.**
- **Limited sessions per camper:** Each camper may register for a maximum of **three** weeks of camp.

### Registration for 2026 Summer Camp opens on **February 3rd, 2026** at 12 p.m. MDT.

[Visit our registration site](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog)

## Weekly Themes

**June 1-5****- Art & Nature** - Welcome to a week of creativity, gentle movement, and connection to nature and each other. Whether you’re using natural materials to create temporary art or activating your observation skills with nature journaling, it’s time to let your creativity flow!

**June 8-12****- Wilderness Skills** - Intrepid explorers unite! Do you know how to start a fire? Build a shelter? Use a map and compass? Identify animal tracks? Learn with us as we discover ways to explore nature and survive the great outdoors!

**June 15-19****- Nature in Flight** - Calling all bird, butterfly, and bat enthusiasts! From tiny moths to giant eagles, explore the fascinating world of birds, insects, and other flying critters! Bust out those binoculars and soar like a hawk during this week of outdoor fun!

**June 22-26****- Life Underground** - From mushrooms and tardigrades to prairie dogs and badgers, there’s a whole world under our feet, just waiting to be discovered. Get ready to get muddy while we explore underground ecosystems, play in the dirt, and feel the squish of mud beneath our toes!

**June 29-July 3** - NO CAMP

**July 6-10****- Let’s Get Outside** - Is your camper always on the go? Join us for a high-energy week of group challenges, water games, hiking, obstacle courses, and more! We will have fun, play together as a team, and enjoy everything outdoor recreation has to offer!

**July 13-17****- Nature in Flight** - Calling all bird, butterfly, and bat enthusiasts! From tiny moths to giant eagles, explore the fascinating world of birds, insects, and other flying critters! Bust out those binoculars and soar like a hawk during this week of outdoor fun!

**July 20-24****- Wilderness Skills** - Intrepid explorers unite! Do you know how to start a fire? Build a shelter? Use a map and compass? Identify animal tracks? Learn with us as we discover ways to explore nature and survive the great outdoors!

**July 27-31****- Life Underground** - From mushrooms and tardigrades to prairie dogs and badgers, there’s a whole world under our feet, just waiting to be discovered. Get ready to get muddy while we explore underground ecosystems, play in the dirt, and feel the squish of mud beneath our toes!

**August 3-7****- Art & Nature** - Welcome to a week of creativity, gentle movement, and connection to nature and each other. Whether you’re using natural materials to create temporary art or activating your observation skills with nature journaling, it’s time to let your creativity flow!

[Las descripciones de temas en Español.](/DocumentCenter/View/6737)

## Ages

Ages 7-11. Please note: Per our state license requirements, campers must be 7 years old at the time of their first day of camp. If your child is currently 6 years old but will be turning 7 before their first day of camp, you should be able to complete your registration as normal but can call 720-898-7405 if you have any complications. Campers that will not be 7 by the first day of camp will not be allowed to stay for our camp per state regulations.

## Cost

$375 per camper per week, includes all supplies and camp t-shirt. Scholarships available.

## Typical Schedule

See below for approximate schedule but times are subject to change  **\*\*Please note: snacks and lunches are NOT provided.\*\***

- 8:30 to 9:00 a.m.: Drop-Off and Free Play
- 9:00 to 9:10 a.m.: Welcome and Intro to the Day
- 9:10 to 10:05 a.m.: Activity 1
- 10:05 to 10:30 a.m.: Snack and Free Play
- 10:30 to 11:25 a.m.: Activity 2
- 11:25 a.m. to 12:25 p.m.: Lunch and Free Play
- 12:30 to 1:30 p.m.: Activity 3
- 1:30 to 2:30 p.m.: Snack and Nature Journals
- 2:30 to 3:30 p.m.: Exploration and Activity 3
- 3:30 to 4:00 p.m.: Free Play and Pick-Up

Activities vary by day. Free play may include crafts/coloring, nature games, or outdoor exploration.

## Location

- Majestic View Nature Center (7030 Garrison Street, Arvada. CO 80004)

## Refund/Cancellation Policy

- All cancellation requests received before end of business day **four weeks before each session**, will receive a full refund minus a $50 processing fee.
- **No refund** will be given for cancellation requests made **within the four weeks** prior to the start of a registered session.
- If for any reason Majestic View Nature Center cancels a camp session, campers will receive a full refund or the opportunity to transfer to another session if space is available.

## Scholarships

If you would like to sign your child up for camp but are experiencing financial hardship, [please submit a scholarship application](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfCphZEeyegurd347OKakdwNJJ9w-SKAhL14nIgRd0hsdNsgQ/viewform?usp=publish-editor) by **January 9th, 2026**. We will make every effort to provide a discounted rate for children enrolled in Title 1 schools and families eligible for free or reduced price school lunches. Families may also qualify based on financial hardship.

## Parent Handbook

The [Parent Handbook](/DocumentCenter/View/7161/2026-MVNC-Parent-Handbook) is an important resource for all adults with a child enrolled in Nature Camp. For questions about any portion of the handbook, please call 720-898-7407 or email [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#482529222d3b3c212b3e212d3f262b08293a3e292c2966273a2f).

## Frequently Asked Questions

- What is your staff to camper ratio? Campers will be supervised at all times by Nature Center Staff. There is an average ratio of 2 teachers for every 10 students.
- What is your camp structure? Our camps are educational, outside, and active programs. Education will be hands-on and engaging, but will require listening, respect, and cooperation by the campers. Educational lessons will be broken up by snack-time, free-time, and other activities. It may be helpful to discuss the educational component with your child before they attend camp to ensure this camp is a good fit.
- What is the City of Arvada’s Federal EIN? The City of Arvada’s Federal EIN is 84-6000633.
